label: Arc Jeans Pocket
description: The arc (curved) jeans pocket is the slash-style five-pocket opening, sweeping in a smooth curve from the waistband down to the side seam. The rounded mouth gives easier hand access than the squared version and softens the front line slightly while keeping the casual denim character. It is the most common front pocket on modern jeans and casual cotton trousers.
